purpose: Schema + minimal structure for future legal/regulatory reference. Three DISTINCT object types, not conflated (corrected in concept-lexeme-resolution sprint).
model: jurisdiction (legal system / scope) --contains/governs context for--> authority (issuing/administering body) --issues/administers--> instrument (statute/regulation/standard/guidance/directive/treaty). An instrument belongs to a jurisdiction and has an issuing authority. A jurisdiction is NOT 'authority + instrument'.

semantic_roles.jurisdiction: The legal/regulatory scope or legal system (e.g. Germany, EU, Morocco as legal systems).
semantic_roles.authority: The institution/body exercising authority within a jurisdiction.
semantic_roles.instrument: The concrete statute, regulation, directive, standard, guidance, or treaty.

rules: Schema and identity structure only in this sprint.
No jurisdictions, authorities, or instruments are added (all lists empty).
Guidance is not law; a draft instrument is not in force; a repealed instrument is not current.
Historical instrument states must remain distinguishable from currently effective states.
This registry never provides legal advice; reference/context only.

jurisdiction_record_schema.note: 'authority' is NOT a field of a jurisdiction record; authorities are separate records referencing jurisdiction_id.
